summary: The §13 R6 self-intersection machinery is landed in vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel/selfint.rs (wired as kernel::selfint in kernel/mod.rs); the nine required tests live in tests/kernel_selfint.rs and all pass. Section 1 (deflation): divided_difference_1d/2d-u/v and shift_1d/u/v realize the exact divided differences [S(u+h,v+k)-S(u,v+k)]/h and [S(u,v+k)-S(u,v)]/k as Bernstein coefficient arithmetic (shift the net into the same basis via the scalar blossom, subtract, divide by the scalar step, exact degree-n to n-1 elevation-inverse reduction), so the deflated residual D1/D2 is a genuine polynomial on the Bezier net, never a sampled finite difference; dyadic test steps keep the divisions exact. For rational S = P/w the residual is carried in the §7.1 NUMERATOR form P(base+delta)*w(base) - P(base)*w(base+delta) (R6System::residual; no weight-bearing division anywhere, the weight bound is a value argument, exactly the R8/R9 S1A discipline). Section 2 (cover + transitions): r6_witness implements Theorem 13.1 exactly on the sign-canonical member of the unordered pair {delta, -delta} (|h| >= |k| -> chart A, |k| > |h| -> chart B, canonical dominant step > 0 so r6_witness(delta) == r6_witness(-delta) and r6_admits admits exactly one of the antipodal pair); r6_transition_type1 (m_A = +1: m_B = 1/m_A, lambda_B = lambda_A*m_A, SegmentBreak::R6ChartSwitch, same base) and r6_transition_type2 (m_A = -1: base-point swap onto the far member, SegmentBreak::R6BaseSwap, far-side chart data repoints to the old base) both preserve the witness per Theorem 13.3/Corollary 13.2 - the tests check the surface-point identity across each break on real fold leaves. Section 3 (Theorem 13.4 lambda=0): at lambda=0 chart A reduces to S_u + m S_v = 0, solvable only at parametric degeneracy; r6_lambda_zero routes a regular leaf back to the charts (LambdaZeroRoute::Chart) and a leaf whose partials are degenerate at the base to the carrier (LambdaZeroRoute::Carrier), and r6_lambda_zero_refusal is the typed refusal of the section 3.4 (contact-classifier) route naming the route in its predicate (RefusalKind::Conditioning, backing Inconclusive) - the contact classifier is never a route. Fixtures: hand-built unit-weight self-overlapping sweep leaves (the degree-3 profile y=(v-1/2)^2, z=-(v-1/2)/16+(v-1/2)^3 self-crosses at y=1/16,z=0 for v=1/4 and 3/4; extruded along x=u, x=u+v, or x=u-v) carry exact dyadic fold pairs with offsets (0,1/2) [chart B], (1/2,-1/2) [chart A m=-1], and (1/2,1/2) [chart A m=+1] respectively; each unordered pair is detected exactly once and delta/-delta canonicalize to the same witness. A plane leaf and a rational stereographic sphere-cap leaf (bidegree (2,2), weights 1+u^2+v^2) show ZERO R6 zeros over the small dyadic fixture domain. House rule H-1 holds: neither new file contains unwrap/expect/panic and neither adds a module-level allow; result_large_err is allowed item-level only with the standard frozen-§2 comment, matching residuals_r89/leaf.rs. N4 holds: no transcendental call in selfint.rs (tested by source scan). No stop condition fired: the frozen seam (graph.rs R6ChartSwitch/R6BaseSwap, the landed BezierLeaf format with its public fields) needed no accessor amendment.

measured_counts.sweep_vert_fold_pair: leaf x = u, bidegree (1,3): unordered pair base (1/2,1/4) <-> far (1/2,3/4), offset (0,1/2), chart B {lambda 0.5, m 0}; dyadic offset scan from the base finds EXACTLY ONE zero offset (0,1/2) and from the far base EXACTLY ONE zero offset (0,-1/2); r6_witness(delta) == r6_witness(-delta) and r6_admits admits exactly one of the antipodal pair.
measured_counts.sweep_minus_fold_pair: leaf x = u - v: fold pair (1/4,1/4) <-> (3/4,3/4), offset (1/2,1/2), chart A {lambda 0.5, m +1}; Type I transition emits R6ChartSwitch with m_B = 1/m_A = 1 and lambda_B = lambda_A*m_A = 0.5 and preserves the far point and the surface witness S(base) = S(far).
measured_counts.sweep_plus_fold_pair: leaf x = u + v: fold pair (1/4,3/4) <-> (3/4,1/4), offset (1/2,-1/2), chart A {lambda 0.5, m -1}; Type II base swap emits R6BaseSwap, moves the base to (3/4,1/4), and the far-side chart data A {lambda -0.5, m -1} repoints to the old base; S(swapped base) == S(old base) (witness preserved).
measured_counts.sphere_cap: rational stereographic cap (x,y,z) = (2u,2v,1-u^2-v^2)/(1+u^2+v^2) at bidegree (2,2): non-unit weights; R6System::residual returns the numerator form P(base+delta)*w(base) - P(base)*w(base+delta) equal to w(base)*w(base+delta)*(S(base+delta)-S(base)) and differing from the weightless numerator difference; ZERO R6 zeros over the 9-base x 5x5-offset dyadic fixture scan.
measured_counts.lambda_zero_routing: regular sweep leaf at base (1/2,1/4) routes m in {-1,0,1} to LambdaZeroRoute::Chart; the degenerate leaf S = (u, v^2-v, v^2-v) at base (1/2,1/2) (S_v = 0) routes to LambdaZeroRoute::Carrier; the section 3.4 route is refused by the typed predicate r6_lambda_zero_section_3_4_route (Conditioning / Inconclusive).
measured_counts.divided_difference_dimensions: cubic (3,3) net: D1 net rows drop to the u degree (3) with the v degree unchanged, D2 net columns drop to the v degree (3) with the u degree unchanged; h*D1 + k*D2 telescopes to S(u+h,v+k) - S(u,v) at every dyadic sample.
